title: Skyline Rush — Live Ops
description: Active District rollout status and Season Pass tier-completion distribution. Implements 12_ANALYTICS_AND_OBSERVABILITY.md §Dashboards bullet 3. Most of this dashboard is placeholder: LiveOpsService serves content packs and feature flags over HTTP but exports no Prometheus series, so rollout state is currently only observable through the config endpoint traffic panel.

panels.title: Live-ops config endpoint traffic by status
panels.description: Real signal available today: how often clients successfully fetch live-ops configuration, and whether those fetches are erroring. Derived from the gateway's http_requests_total, which labels unrouted paths as "unmatched" to bound cardinality (CLAUDE.md §8). RF-05: the selector must match the path label values the gateway actually emits (req.route.path). The only registered live-ops route today is GET /v1/liveops/config; the previous /v1/config.*|/v1/content.* selector matched nothing and rendered No Data permanently.

panels.title: Run volume (live-ops load proxy)
panels.description: Runs submitted per second. Used as the denominator when judging whether a District rollout changed engagement, and as the load proxy for capacity decisions during an event.

panels.title: Active District rollout percentage
panels.description: PLACEHOLDER: skyline_liveops_rollout_percentage{district} is not emitted. LiveOpsService (apps/liveops/liveops.service.ts) resolves content packs and feature flags per request but holds no exported gauge for rollout state. Renders No Data until a liveops exporter publishes the active rollout percentage per district.

panels.title: Content pack publish failures
panels.description: PLACEHOLDER: skyline_liveops_pack_publish_failures_total is not emitted. Content packs are validated against schemas/content-pack.schema.json in the contracts package, but publish outcomes are not counted at runtime.

panels.title: Season Pass tier-completion distribution
panels.description: PLACEHOLDER: skyline_season_pass_tier_players is not emitted. Contract progress is persisted per player (contract_progress) but never aggregated into a distribution series. Renders No Data until a batch exporter publishes the tier histogram in aggregate-only form.
